text: Aillén, brother of Áine, appears in Irish myth. Áine is the goddess and fairy queen of Munster. Aillén fell in love with the wife of the sea god Manannán Mac Lir.
objective: Record Aillén, brother of the goddess Áine.
key_results: Show his kinship with Áine and his love for the spouse of the sea god.
